purpose: Choose one short API coding task for a three-agent, three-minute Itera demonstration.

shared_protocol.comparison_note: The last two arms isolate the generic skill effect only if model, version, sampling, tools, budget and fixture are identical. The premium comparison measures the whole model-plus-harness configuration.
shared_protocol.fixture_rules: Pin one monorepo Git commit and one container image digest. Export only benchmarks/<scenario>/fixture into each network-disabled agent workspace, without .git or evaluator files. Use the same prompt, public tests and limits. Hidden tests stay under benchmarks/<scenario>/evaluator/hidden in the same monorepo, but outside all agent workspaces; mount them only in the evaluator after the patch is frozen.
shared_protocol.runtime_note: Budget is a target, not an observed latency. Pilot the full pipeline and use a signed, clearly labeled prior-run replay if p95 cannot fit. Never label replay as live.
shared_protocol.onchain_claim: Commit the canonical manifest digest and issuer identity on Solana. The transaction proves that a specific manifest was recorded, not that a skill claim is intrinsically true.
shared_protocol.test_security: Tests and scoring commands are evaluator-owned and mounted after patch freeze. Reject changes to package scripts, test runners and protected paths. Run untrusted patches in a network-disabled container with CPU, memory, process and wall-time limits.

scenarios.title: Idempotent settlement webhook

repo_fixture_shape.state: Small in-memory ledger behind POST /events and GET /settlements/:id; deterministic fake clock; no external API or real money.
repo_fixture_shape.initial_defect: POST /events increments settled amount on every delivery, accepts invalid signatures and lets an older pending event overwrite a settled state.
repo_fixture_shape.agent_workspace: fixture subtree export only; no monorepo root, .git, or evaluator paths

scenarios.agent_prompt: Fix POST /events. Verify the HMAC-SHA256 signature over the raw request body using the supplied fixture key. Process each event ID at most once. A settled event must not move back to pending. Preserve the response contract and existing tests. Do not edit any file under tests/ -- your fix is graded by hidden tests mounted after your patch is frozen, and any change under tests/ is out of scope and will be rejected.
public_checks: duplicate event ID returns unchanged settlement
hidden_checks: invalid signature has no side effects
same event ID with altered payload cannot change ledger
out-of-order pending after settled cannot regress state
two concurrent duplicate deliveries settle once
different event IDs for same settlement follow the documented transition order
demo_visible_evidence: side-by-side changed files and patch diff
signed valid event and duplicate request shown as HTTP responses
event trace and canonical manifest hash with Solana transaction state

expected_discrimination_hypothesis.premium_model: May cover signature, idempotency and state ordering within budget.
expected_discrimination_hypothesis.low_cost_open_with_skill: A generic inspect-test-patch-retest skill may help find the duplicate and out-of-order edge cases.
expected_discrimination_hypothesis.same_low_cost_open_without_skill: May fix the visible duplicate symptom but miss the hidden state or signature case.
expected_discrimination_hypothesis.caveat: These are hypotheses. Pilot at least several seeds before choosing the task; do not stage a predicted winner.

key_risks: HMAC wording must specify raw bytes and key to avoid ambiguous grading
concurrency may expose fixture implementation race rather than agent quality
task-specific skill hints would invalidate the skill comparison
security-themed task may imply real payment assurance; use synthetic events only

scenarios.title: Stable event-feed pagination

repo_fixture_shape.state: GET /events?limit=&cursor= over an in-memory list with fixed seed data and deterministic insert operations.
repo_fixture_shape.initial_defect: Offset pagination repeats or skips records when a new event arrives; timestamp ties produce unstable ordering.
repo_fixture_shape.agent_workspace: fixture subtree export only; no monorepo root, .git, or evaluator paths

scenarios.agent_prompt: Replace offset pagination with a cursor. Order events by created_at descending, then ID descending. A page request must never repeat or skip an event that existed when the first page was read, even after a new insertion. Return a 400 response for malformed cursors. Keep the response shape and existing tests.
public_checks: next cursor returns a disjoint page
empty page has no next cursor
hidden_checks: insertion between pages does not repeat or skip original records
demo_visible_evidence: new event inserted between page requests
test score bars and manifest hash

expected_discrimination_hypothesis.premium_model: May implement a composite cursor and preserve the response contract.
expected_discrimination_hypothesis.low_cost_open_with_skill: A generic edge-case checklist may prompt tie-breaker and malformed-cursor tests.
expected_discrimination_hypothesis.same_low_cost_open_without_skill: May replace offset with timestamp-only cursor and fail tie cases.
expected_discrimination_hypothesis.caveat: The ranking is untested; include deterministic ties in the visible specification.

key_risks: Snapshot guarantee needs explicit semantics; either carry a first-page upper bound or narrow the claim
opaque cursor signing can distract from pagination behavior
small fixtures may be solved by hardcoding unless hidden seeds vary
database-independent fixture is less realistic than a production feed

scenarios.title: Concurrent API quota reservation

repo_fixture_shape.state: FastAPI-like local HTTP adapter backed by SQLite, fixed account quota and deterministic clock; no external provider.
repo_fixture_shape.initial_defect: POST /reservations reads remaining quota before it writes, so simultaneous requests can over-reserve; retrying a request consumes quota twice.
repo_fixture_shape.agent_workspace: fixture subtree export only; no monorepo root, .git, or evaluator paths

scenarios.agent_prompt: Fix POST /reservations so concurrent requests never reserve more than the account quota. The Idempotency-Key header must return the first result on an identical retry and return 409 if that key is reused with a changed payload. Return 409 when quota is exhausted. Keep GET /quota and existing responses compatible. Add or update a test.
public_checks: same idempotency key returns the first result
hidden_checks: failed reservation does not consume quota
same key with changed payload returns 409
demo_visible_evidence: per-agent patch and concurrency test outcome
manifest hash and Solana proof state

expected_discrimination_hypothesis.premium_model: May add an atomic transaction and preserve idempotency semantics.
expected_discrimination_hypothesis.low_cost_open_with_skill: A generic concurrency-test workflow may expose the read-then-write race.
expected_discrimination_hypothesis.same_low_cost_open_without_skill: May add only a sequential check that still races.
expected_discrimination_hypothesis.caveat: The expected spread is untested and may reflect SQLite familiarity, not general coding ability.

key_risks: Concurrent test can be flaky unless a deterministic barrier controls interleaving
SQLite transaction mode and connection setup must be pinned
Python environment setup can consume live-demo time
the fixture may test database knowledge more than general agent quality

repository_policy: All application, fixture, public test, evaluator, and hidden-test source lives in one monorepo. The runner exports only the chosen fixture subtree into each agent sandbox; it never clones the full repository into an agent workspace.
